user.title: Frigate notifications

data_description.auto_discover: Add every Frigate camera as it's found. Switch off to be offered each one instead
data_description.discover_zones: Offer each Frigate zone like a camera, for notifications about that zone alone

confirm.title: Notifications for {name}
confirm.description:
Get notified when Frigate sees something at {name}?

{supernotify}

discovery.title: Automatic discovery
discovery.description: Cameras and zones already set up are left as they are.

data_description.auto_discover: Add every Frigate camera as it's found. Switch off to be offered each one instead
data_description.discover_zones: Offer each Frigate zone like a camera, for notifications about that zone alone

data_description.severities: Which of Frigate's reviews to notify. Alerts are what Frigate is set to treat as important, detections are everything else it tracks.
data_description.labels: Only notify when one of these is seen or heard. Leave empty for anything.
data_description.zones: Only notify when one of these zones is entered. Leave empty for anywhere.
data_description.zone_multi: Only notify once every zone chosen has been entered, rather than any of them.
data_description.zone_order: Only notify when the zones chosen are entered in the order listed, such as from the gate to the door.

timing.name: Timing
timing.description: When notifications are sent, and how often.

data_description.cooldown: Time after a notification before another is sent for something new. Updates of what's already been notified aren't held back.
data_description.initial_delay: Wait this long before the first notification, for a better snapshot.
data_description.final_update: Send one more notification once Frigate has finished with what it saw.
data_description.final_delay: Wait this long after it's over before that last notification.
data_description.timeout: No more updates after this long, however long it goes on.
data_description.alert_once: Updates replace the first notification silently, rather than sounding again.
data_description.update_sub_label: Send an update when Frigate recognises a face or a number plate.

notify.name: Notification targets
notify.description: Who and what is notified. Leave everything empty for the usual choice.

data_description.targets: Notify entities to send to. Leave empty for every phone with the Home Assistant app.
data_description.target: Who or what to notify, as for any Supernotify notification. Leave empty for Supernotify to choose.
data_description.custom_target: Targets outside of Home Assistant, such as e-mail addresses or phone numbers.
data_description.deliveries: Limit notifications to these Supernotify deliveries. Leave empty for Supernotify to choose.
